A '''Magnetic pulse accelerator''' was a type of limited [[magnetic accelerator]] used in [[Cycler rifle/Legends|Tusken Cycler rifles]]. Magnetic pulse accelerators propelled projectiles through the barrels of these rifles, giving the rifle its range and stopping power.<ref name="FF" />
